description: The 11 venue archetypes with their measured bands (energy/valence/acousticness/tempo min–max) and typical categories. Use these to translate a venue kind into find_venues parameters. Energy/valence/acousticness bands are percent 0–100 (matching find_venues); tempo is BPM. Each archetype also carries `genre_profile`: the genre mix of its shared sample pool — use it to set expectations honestly (e.g. whether jazz features at all). It describes the pool, never an individual venue.
name: list_archetypes
